build-app.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /work/source
export PATH=/work/tools/rust/bin:$PATH CARGO_HOME=/work/cache/cargo GOPATH=/work/cache/go GOCACHE=/work/cache/go-build GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOMAXPROCS=4 GOPROXY=https://goproxy.cn,direct GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org
go version
rustc --version
test "$(go version | awk '{print $3}')" = go1.26.7
if [ ! -f /usr/include/sqlite3.h ]; then
 sed -i 's@deb.debian.org@mirrors.ustc.edu.cn@g' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources
 apt-get update > /work/artifacts/apt-update.log 2>&1
 apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libsqlite3-dev binutils file > /work/artifacts/apt-install.log 2>&1
fi
bash scripts/build-anydoc-lib.sh > /work/artifacts/anydoc-build.log 2>&1
go test -p 2 -tags anydoc ./internal/application/service ./internal/handler ./internal/config ./internal/middleware ./internal/utils ./internal/tracing/langfuse -run 'SourceID|OIDC|AuthToken|SwitchTenant|Login|Logout|GenerateTokens|ValidateToken|RefreshToken' -count=1 > /work/artifacts/auth-tests.log 2>&1
go test -p 2 -tags anydoc ./cmd/sourceid-enroll > /work/artifacts/enrollment-tests.log 2>&1
export VERSION=0.8.0-sourceid-business-2fcbcaaed COMMIT_ID=2fcbcaaed BUILD_TIME=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) GO_VERSION=1.26.7
make build-prod GO_BUILD_TAGS=anydoc > /work/artifacts/app-build.log 2>&1
cp WeKnora /work/artifacts/WeKnora
go build -o /work/artifacts/sourceid-enroll ./cmd/sourceid-enroll
printf 'APP_BUILD_PASS
'

go build -o /work/artifacts/sourceid-binding ./cmd/sourceid-binding
build-frontend.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /work/source/frontend
export PATH=/work/tools/node/bin:$PATH
export NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144
export npm_config_cache=/work/cache/npm
node --version
npm cache add /work/toolchain/xlsx-0.20.2.tgz > /work/artifacts/sheetjs-cache.log 2>&1
npm ci --prefer-offline > /work/artifacts/npm-ci.log 2>&1
npm run type-check > /work/artifacts/frontend-types.log 2>&1
VITE_IS_DOCKER=true VITE_FRONTEND_COMMIT=2fcbcaaed npm run build > /work/artifacts/frontend-build.log 2>&1
cp -a dist /work/artifacts/dist
printf 'FRONTEND_BUILD_PASS\n'
